experiment: P5e five-model-seed replication of the frozen bounded JNR-only attachment
research_question: Does the already frozen P5b3 posterior-conditioned analytic attachment retain its MFT/VFT/ISRJ JNR benefit when the P4c source-model stochastic sample is extended from three to five independently trained models, before one final two-new-identity confirmation?
single_changed_axis: only the number of independently trained P4c source models changes from 3 to 5; architecture, data role, loss, thresholds, analytic features, head architecture, optimizer, checkpoint objective and attachment cells are fixed

parents.P5d_stop: P5d is not reused for selection, training, thresholding, routing or confirmation

source_model_replication.base_profile: cos_lr1e4_wd1e4, width24, head256, parameter_head64, dropout0.2, BCE + 0.1 masked SmoothL1, 20 epochs, parameter-NMAE early checkpoint
source_model_replication.head_profile: same P5b3 26 analytic features plus frozen six-label posterior, 64-hidden MLP, masked SmoothL1, AdamW lr=0.001 wd=0.0001, max 30 epochs, patience 5
forbidden: base weight update after checkpoint selection

confirmation_after_and_only_after_develo.evaluation: read-only all-five-model comparison, no training/selection/calibration/threshold adjustment

stop_rule: If either new source model fails development gates, stop and retain P5b4 as three-model/two-data-seed evidence. If any five-model fresh-confirmation gate fails, do not alter the attachment or use it in a final system claim. Neither outcome permits reusing P5b4, P5c, P5d or any consumed test data.
